reports.title: Bausch + Lomb Posts Strong Third-Quarter Performance, Raises Full-Year 2026 Guidance

lines: 3 The increase in the anticipated full-year revenue is a result of a $15 million increase in the underlying business outlook, based on continued strong business performance in the third quarter of 2026 and anticipated stronger business performance for the remainder of 2026, partially offset by a decrease of $5 million in expected currency tailwinds (such decrease is a result of exchange rates moderating).
